newsitem.title: USA: Unocal Spirit well begins production.
newsitem.headline: Unocal Spirit well begins production.

text.p: Unocal Corp said Monday its Spirit Energy 76 unit had begun production from the first horizontal well drilled in the Ship Shoal 266 field offshore Louisiana.

The well raises peak daily field production to more than 2,800 barrels of oil and 19 million cubic feet of natural gas, Unocal said. The A-15 well encountered 406 feet of pay in a horizontal section below 5,471 feet. It is now producing 700 barrels of oil per day and 148,000 cubic feet of natural gas.
The company said it expects to drill additional wells in the field this year.
The company also said that production from Spirit Energy's Mobile 904 field offshore Mississippi had risen to 52 million cubic feet per day.

Spirit had announced the start of production in early January at 33 million cubic feet per day. Spirit has a 66.67 percent working interest in the Mobile 904 field. while Vastar Resources Inc owns the remaining interest.
